|notes=* Decipher published this errata as text only, in the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998). The main image is that entry, cut unchanged from page 48. Printed face: [[Dengar's Blaster Carbine]]. Side-by-side faces: [[Errata]].
* Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered [[Dengar's Blaster Carbine (Revised)]] (December 1999), read word for word off the card image.
* The Players Committee's [[Dengar's Blaster Carbine (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] prints the same words as a slip.
* The Players Committee's D-E1 card does not print exactly these words: it adds a comma (“a character, creature, or vehicle”).
* The card picture below it was built by swccg.com in 2026 in the card maker from Decipher's printed [[Dengar's Blaster Carbine]], with the game text replaced by Decipher's errata word for word; the maker's mark swccg.com 2026 ends its legal line.
